octane.options.restart: Takes effect after a game restart.
octane.options.cacheRecipes.tooltip: Reuses parsed recipes between launches so the world loads faster.
octane.options.cacheSplashes.tooltip: Keeps the splash list in memory instead of re-reading it on every reload.
octane.options.skipRedundantBake.tooltip: Parses each model file once and reuses the result during resource reloads.
octane.options.silenceMissingSounds.tool: Stops the log from filling up with missing sound warnings.
octane.options.particleGovernor.tooltip: Trims particle spam from farms and boss fights. Gameplay stays untouched.
octane.options.particleCullDistance.tool: Particles spawned farther than this many blocks are skipped.
octane.options.particleCapPerTick.toolti: Most new particles accepted in a single tick. The rest are dropped.
octane.options.particleAliveThreshold.to: Above this many live particles, only one in four new ones is accepted.
octane.options.weatherParticleThinning.t: Halves how often rain splash particles spawn.
octane.options.soundGovernor.tooltip: Skips distant positional sounds. Music, voice and weather always play.
octane.options.soundCullDistance.tooltip: Sounds farther than this many blocks are skipped.
octane.options.entityCull.tooltip: Stops drawing entities beyond the distance below. Only visuals change.
octane.options.entityCullDistance.toolti: Entities farther than this many blocks are not rendered.
octane.options.nameTagCullDistance.toolt: Name tags farther than this many blocks are hidden. 64 matches vanilla.
